content.explanation: (1) violates. (2) allowed: review need not mean approval. (3) implies notA. (4) gives no conclusion about R. Contrapositive notR⇒notA. A reviewed but rejected submission has R=true,A=false, refuting the converse. The policy is a requirement, not evidence that every real system complies.
